quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results release adds the GAAP figures: GAAP revenue $193.4 million, up 13% sequentially and up 94% year-over-year; GAAP hardware revenue $110.6 million (up 59% year-over-year) and cloud and other services revenue $82.8 million (up 178%); GAAP gross margin 45% (hardware 41%, cloud and other services 49%); GAAP loss from operations $15.0 million and GAAP net loss $14.0 million. Purchases of property and equipment were $131,970 thousand in the quarter versus $98,244 thousand a year earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: GAAP revenue $193.4 million (+94% YoY); GAAP gross margin 45%; Q1 purchases of property and equipment $131,970 thousand (vs $98,244 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 release product highlights: Cerebras co-launched Codex-Spark with OpenAI, a model designed for near-instant coding delivering more than 1,000 tokens per second, and launched enterprise customer trials of Kimi K2.6 - the first trillion-parameter model served on Cerebras, approaching 1,000 tokens per second as measured by Artificial Analysis - and Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 31B.
quarterly_data.figure: Codex-Spark more than 1,000 tokens per second; Kimi K2.6 approaching 1,000 tokens per second
